title: The Young Girls of Rochefort
description: Dancing/composing twin sisters (Catherine Deneuve, Françoise Dorléac) find romance in Paris, one with a sailor, the other with a U.S. pianist (Jacques Perrin).

title: The Umbrellas of Cherbourg
description: A pregnant French girl (Catherine Deneuve) must choose between her lover (Nino Castelnuovo), who is going into the service, and a very wealthy merchant; all dialogue is sung.

title: All Mine to Give
description: An orphan (Rex Thompson) raised by Scottish pioneers (Glynis Johns, Cameron Mitchell) in Wisconsin seeks homes for his five younger siblings on Christmas.

title: The Cobweb
description: The director (Richard Widmark) of a psychiatric clinic presides over the crisis of selecting new curtains for the library.

title: A Summer Place
description: A man (Richard Egan) and a woman's (Dorothy McGuire) Maine-coast adultery parallels his teenage daughter's (Sandra Dee) romance with her son.

title: Invitation
description: A rich man buys a husband (Van Johnson) for his invalid daughter (Dorothy McGuire), who has only one year to live, but she finds out.

title: A Life of Her Own
description: A top New York model (Lana Turner) has an affair with a millionaire (Ray Milland) whose wife is disabled.

title: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
description: Two brothers, one an alcoholic (Paul Newman) who resents his devoted wife (Elizabeth Taylor), visit their dying millionaire father (Burl Ives) in the South.

title: East of Eden
description: Rebellious Cal (James Dean) competes with his twin, Aron, for the love of his rigid father (Raymond Massey) and for a girl in 1917 California.

title: Across the Wide Missouri
description: A beaver trapper (Clark Gable) marries a Blackfoot chief's daughter who guides his group safely West.

title: Mark of the Renegade
description: An agent of Mexico poses as a pirate to foil a would-be emperor in the 1820s California.

title: The Saracen Blade
description: Pietro, a peasant hoping to avenge his father's death at the hands of a greedy count and his son, joins the Crusades and returns to Italy a hero, where he resumes his vendetta against his father's killers.

title: Cheyenne Autumn
description: A cavalry captain (Richard Widmark) is ordered to stop 300 Cheyennes migrating from Oklahoma to Wyoming.

title: How the West Was Won
description: The history of 19th-century Western expansion, as seen through the lives of three generations of a pioneer family.

title: The Hard Way
description: A scheming small-town woman (Ida Lupino) uses men to get her sister-in-law (Joan Leslie) on Broadway.

title: Old Acquaintance
description: Two best friends from girlhood clash over the years as serious writer (Bette Davis) and racy novelist (Miriam Hopkins).

title: Pillow to Post
description: A tired traveling saleswoman poses as an officer's wife at a bungalow camp for military couples only.

title: Nora Prentiss
description: A nightclub singer (Ann Sheridan) inspires a doctor (Kent Smith) to fake his own murder, for which he stands trial.

title: Backfire
description: A World War II veteran (Gordon MacRae) and his nurse (Virginia Mayo) search for his buddy (Edmond O'Brien), a reformed hoodlum on the run.

title: The Damned Don't Cry
description: An oil-field worker's wife (Joan Crawford) climbs the social ladder as a public enemy's (David Brian) mink-draped mistress.

title: The Young Philadelphians
description: An ambitious lawyer's (Paul Newman) claim to a prominent family name is open to the glare of a murder trial.

title: The Four Musketeers
description: Athos (Oliver Reed), Porthos, Aramis (Richard Chamberlain) and D'Artagnan defend the queen and her dressmaker (Raquel Welch) from Cardinal Richelieu and Milady.

title: Robin and Marian
description: Aging Robin Hood (Sean Connery) returns from war and finds Maid Marian (Audrey Hepburn) in a nunnery and the sheriff of Nottingham (Robert Shaw) in charge.

title: Swashbuckler
description: Caribbean pirates (Robert Shaw, James Earl Jones) assist a noble damsel and foil a quirky tyrant (Peter Boyle).

title: Sword of Sherwood Forest
description: Robin Hood (Richard Greene) and company save the Archbishop of Canterbury from an earl and the sheriff of Nottingham (Peter Cushing).

title: The Pirates of Blood River
description: A one-eyed French pirate (Christopher Lee) forces a prisoner (Kerwin Mathews) to lead the way to treasure in the West Indies.

title: Seven Seas to Calais
description: Sir Francis Drake (Rod Taylor) and his buccaneers save the queen (Irene Worth) and fight the Spanish Armada.

title: The Swordsman of Siena
description: A 16th-century swashbuckler (Stewart Granger) sides with an Italian beauty (Sylva Koscina) against a Spanish tyrant.

title: The Red Danube
description: A British colonel (Walter Pidgeon) must surrender a refugee Russian ballerina loved by a major (Peter Lawford) in postwar Vienna.

title: If Winter Comes
description: A writer (Walter Pidgeon) of British schoolbooks befriends a pregnant girl, and it costs him his wife (Angela Lansbury) and job.

title: The Secret Heart
description: A teenager's (June Allyson) despondency over her father's suicide causes concern for her brother and stepmother (Claudette Colbert). Narrated by Hume Cronyn.

title: These Wilder Years
description: A self-made man's (James Cagney) search for his illegitimate son ends at a woman's (Barbara Stanwyck) home for unwed mothers.

title: Forbidden Planet
description: An astronaut (Leslie Nielsen) and crew land on Altair-4 in 2200 and find a mad doctor (Walter Pidgeon), his daughter (Anne Francis) and Robby the robot.

title: Mrs. Miniver
description: William Wyler's Oscar-winning classic about the tensions faced by a family of hard-working Brits in war-torn England.

title: Chuck Amuck: The Movie
description: Animator Chuck Jones traces his role in the evolution of such characters as Bugs Bunny and details the animation process.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Rabbit of Seville
Bugs and Elmer Fudd stage a bizarre version of "The Barber of Seville" after Elmer chases Bugs into a packed theater.

title: One Froggy Evening
description: A man tries desperately to strike it rich with a talented frog that can sing and dance, but the owner is the only one who ever sees it perform.

title: Gay Purr-ee
description: A starry-eyed cat grows weary of life on a French farm and heads for the excitement of 1890s Paris, followed by her tomcat suitor, Jaune-Tom, and his furry cohort, Robespierre.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Duck Amuck
Daffy Duck is tormented by an animator's hand, who constantly changes locations, props and traps for Daffy to fall into.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
What's Opera, Doc?
Elmer Fudd is hunting Bugs Bunny and chases him into an opera where they act out their characters.

title: The Phantom Tollbooth
description: A bored schoolboy (Butch Patrick) drives a toy car into a cartoon land, the Kingdom of Wisdom. Animated/live action.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
The Scarlet Pumpernickle
Daffy Duck wants to become a daredevil, aspiring to be as clever as a fox like his storybook heroes.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Haredevil Hare
Bugs gets blasted into space and makes it all the way up to the moon.

title: Vertigo
description: A former San Francisco detective (James Stewart) who dreads heights falls for a woman (Kim Novak) he is hired to protect.

title: Night Must Fall
description: An English widow (Mona Washbourne) and her niece (Susan Hampshire) are charmed by a working-class ax killer (Albert Finney) who keeps a head in a box.

title: Chandler
description: A private eye (Warren Oates) is hired to follow a mobster's former mistress (Leslie Caron).

title: The Story of Three Loves
description: A ballerina (Moira Shearer) risks her life; a governess (Leslie Caron) is wooed by her charge; an aerialist (Kirk Douglas) finds a new partner.

title: Gaby
description: A ballerina (Leslie Caron) falls in love with a U.S. paratrooper (John Kerr) on a two-day pass in World War II London.

title: The Glass Slipper
description: Mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, scullery maid Ella (Leslie Caron) finally meets her prince (Michael Wilding).

title: Lili
description: A French teen (Leslie Caron) joins a carnival and meets a lying magician (Jean-Pierre Aumont) and a loving puppeteer (Mel Ferrer).
